rider.zh: 騎士、騎乘者（騎馬、機車、腳踏車）

ex.en: Motorcycle riders must wear helmets.
ex.zh: 騎機車的人必須戴安全帽。

ex.en: She is an experienced horse rider.
ex.zh: 她是經驗豐富的騎馬好手。

rider.en: a person who sits on and controls a horse, bike or motorcycle

ex.en: Bus riders will face a fare increase next month.
ex.zh: 公車乘客下個月將面臨票價調漲。

ex.en: The subway carries over two million riders a day.
ex.zh: 捷運每天載運超過兩百萬名乘客。

rider.en: a person who travels on a bus, train or other public transport

ex.en: The contract includes a rider on overtime pay.
ex.zh: 合約附有一條關於加班費的附加條款。

ex.en: You can add a rider to your insurance policy.
ex.zh: 你可以在保單上加保附約。

rider.en: an extra condition added to a contract or insurance paper

ex.en: I don't want to do anything risky.
ex.zh: 我不想做任何冒險的事。

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高的利息。

ex.en: Investing all your money in one stock is risky.
ex.zh: 把所有錢都投資在一支股票上很冒險。

risky.en: having a chance of danger, loss or failure

ex.en: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
ex.zh: 暴動爆發時，只有一名獄警在值班。

ex.en: Police were called in to stop the riot.
ex.zh: 警方被找來平息騷亂。

ex.en: A riot broke out after the football match.
ex.zh: 足球賽結束後爆發了暴動。

riot.en: a violent and noisy protest by a crowd

ex.en: This game got rigged.
ex.zh: 這場比賽被動了手腳。

ex.en: Many people believe the contest was rigged.
ex.zh: 很多人認為這場比賽被操縱了。

rig.en: to control the result of something in a dishonest way

ex.en: He works on an oil rig in the North Sea.
ex.zh: 他在北海的鑽油平台工作。

ex.en: The camera rig is quite heavy.
ex.zh: 這套攝影裝備相當重。

rig.en: a large structure or set of equipment used for a special job, such as getting oil

ex.en: The company has very rigid rules about working hours.
ex.zh: 公司對上班時間的規定非常死板。

ex.en: His schedule is too rigid to change.
ex.zh: 他的行程太緊，沒辦法更動。

rigid.en: very strict and hard to change

ex.en: He was rigid with terror.
ex.zh: 他嚇得全身僵硬。

ex.en: The box is made of rigid plastic.
ex.zh: 這個盒子是用硬塑膠做的。

rigid.en: stiff and not able to bend

rightly.zh: 正確地；有理由地、理所當然地

ex.en: You think rightly.
ex.zh: 你想得沒錯。

ex.en: As you rightly pointed out, the deadline is too tight.
ex.zh: 正如你正確指出的，期限太趕了。

ex.en: She was rightly proud of her team's work.
ex.zh: 她理所當然地為團隊的成果感到驕傲。

rightly.en: in a correct way, or for good reasons

ex.en: All products go through rigorous testing before release.
ex.zh: 所有產品上市前都要經過嚴格測試。

ex.en: The company has a rigorous hiring process.
ex.zh: 這家公司的招募流程很嚴格。

ex.en: Her research is known for its rigorous methods.
ex.zh: 她的研究以方法嚴謹著稱。

ex.en: Due to the heavy rain, vegetable prices have risen.
ex.zh: 因為大雨，菜價上漲了。

ex.en: The cost of living in the United States was rising.
ex.zh: 美國的生活費用一直在上漲。

rise.en: to go up or become higher in amount

ex.en: The sun rises earlier in summer than in winter.
ex.zh: 夏天太陽比冬天升起得早。

ex.en: We got up early to watch the sun rise.
ex.zh: 我們早起看日出。

rise.en: to come up above the horizon, as the sun does

ex.en: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
ex.zh: 這項政策導致物價大幅上漲。

ex.en: Workers are asking for a pay rise.
ex.zh: 員工要求加薪。

rise.en: an increase in amount, number or level

ex.en: Such a plan will give rise to many problems.
ex.zh: 這樣的計畫會引發很多問題。

ex.en: The new policy gave rise to many complaints.
ex.zh: 新政策引起了許多抱怨。

ex.en: I was taking a bath when the telephone rang.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡的時候電話響了。

ex.en: "The phone is ringing." "I'll get it."
ex.zh: 「電話響了。」「我來接。」

ex.en: The bell has not rung yet.
ex.zh: 鈴聲還沒響。

ring.en: to make a clear sound, as a bell or phone does

ex.en: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!
ex.zh: 我們之間結束了，把戒指還給我！

ex.en: She wears a wedding ring.
ex.zh: 她戴著結婚戒指。

ring.en: a small circle of metal worn on a finger

ex.en: I'll ring you as soon as I get home.
ex.zh: 我一回到家就打電話給你。

ex.en: I'll ring you back later.
ex.zh: 我晚點再回你電話。

ex.en: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.
ex.zh: 他很有錢，卻過得像個乞丐。

ex.en: He is richer than anyone else in this town.
ex.zh: 他比鎮上其他人都有錢。

ex.en: The richest man in the world cannot buy everything.
ex.zh: 就算是世界首富也買不到所有東西。

rich.en: having a lot of money or things of value

ex.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
ex.zh: 柳橙富含維生素 C。

ex.en: Taiwan has a rich food culture.
ex.zh: 台灣有豐富的飲食文化。

rich.en: containing a lot of something good

ex.en: This cake is too rich for me.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕對我來說太膩了。

ex.en: The sauce is rich and creamy.
ex.zh: 這醬汁濃郁滑順。

rich.en: containing a lot of fat, butter or sugar, so it feels heavy to eat

ex.en: The boy rode a horse for the first time.
ex.zh: 那個男孩第一次騎馬。

ex.en: Tom said he wanted to try riding a unicycle.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他想試試騎單輪車。

ex.en: I ride my bike to work every day.
ex.zh: 我每天騎腳踏車上班。

ride.en: to sit on a horse or bike and control it as it moves

ex.en: My son always gets sick when he rides a bus.
ex.zh: 我兒子每次搭公車都會暈車。

ex.en: We rode the MRT to the night market.
ex.zh: 我們搭捷運去夜市。

ride.en: to travel in a bus, train or car

ex.en: Do you want me to give you a ride?
ex.zh: 要不要我載你一程？

ex.en: It's a short ride from the airport to the hotel.
ex.zh: 從機場到飯店只要一小段車程。

ride.en: a trip in a vehicle, or the time such a trip takes

ex.en: He surpasses his rivals in all ways.
ex.zh: 他在各方面都勝過對手。

ex.en: Don't hold your rival cheap.
ex.zh: 不要輕視你的對手。

ex.en: Our main rival lowered its prices last month.
ex.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手上個月降價了。

rival.en: a person or group that tries to be better than you or win against you

ex.en: He was hired away by a rival company.
ex.zh: 他被一家競爭對手公司挖角了。

ex.en: The two rival teams play each other tonight.
ex.zh: 這兩支敵對的球隊今晚交手。

rival.en: competing against another person or group

ex.en: Few cities can rival Paris for its food.
ex.zh: 論美食，很少有城市比得上巴黎。

ex.en: The new phone rivals much more expensive models.
ex.zh: 這支新手機可以媲美貴得多的機型。

rival.en: to be as good as someone or something else

rid.zh: get rid of：擺脫、丟掉、除掉

ex.en: We got rid of the mice in their house.
ex.zh: 我們幫他們除掉了家裡的老鼠。

ex.en: I need to get rid of some old clothes.
ex.zh: 我得把一些舊衣服處理掉。

rid.en: to remove something you do not want, or throw it away

rid.zh: 使擺脫、清除（rid A of B）

ex.en: The new software will rid us of these errors.
ex.zh: 新軟體能讓我們擺脫這些錯誤。

ex.en: We want to rid the office of paper waste.
ex.zh: 我們想消除辦公室的紙張浪費。

rid.en: to make a place or person free of something unwanted

ex.en: I'd like mapo tofu, and two bowls of rice.
ex.zh: 我要一份麻婆豆腐和兩碗白飯。

ex.en: Can I have seconds on rice and cabbage?
ex.zh: 我可以再來一份飯和高麗菜嗎？

rice.en: small white or brown grains that are cooked and eaten

ex.en: This year promises a good harvest of rice.
ex.zh: 今年稻米可望豐收。

ex.en: A festival is held at the rice harvest.
ex.zh: 稻子收成時會舉辦祭典。

rice.en: the plant that is grown in wet fields to produce food grains

ex.en: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
ex.zh: 把他們所有的錢都花光太荒謬了。

ex.en: Such a ridiculous superstition no longer exists.
ex.zh: 這種荒謬的迷信已經不存在了。

ex.en: You're just being ridiculous.
ex.zh: 你真是太誇張了。

ridiculous.en: very silly, so that people laugh at it

ex.en: We hiked along the ridge for two hours.
ex.zh: 我們沿著山脊健行了兩小時。

ex.en: The view from the ridge was amazing.
ex.zh: 從山脊上看出去的景色好極了。

ridge.en: a long, narrow top of a hill or mountain

ex.en: The roof has a ridge in the middle.
ex.zh: 屋頂中間有一道屋脊。

ex.en: You can feel a small ridge on the back of the key.
ex.zh: 你可以摸到鑰匙背面有一小道凸起。

ridge.en: a long, narrow raised line on a surface

ex.en: Can you answer this riddle?
ex.zh: 你猜得出這個迷語嗎？

ex.en: It is a must to guess lantern riddles during the Lantern Festival.
ex.zh: 元宵節要猜燈謎。

ex.en: The teacher told us a riddle to start the lesson.
ex.zh: 老師出了一個謎語來開始這堂課。

riddle.en: a question with a clever or funny answer that is hard to guess

ex.en: He felt righteous anger at the unfair treatment.
ex.zh: 他對這種不公平的對待感到正義的憤怒。

ex.en: She was a righteous woman who always helped the poor.
ex.zh: 她是個正直的女人，總是幫助窮人。

righteous.en: morally good and fair, or feeling that you are morally right

ex.en: She ripped her dress on a branch.
ex.zh: 她的裙子被樹枝勾破了。

ex.en: I ripped the envelope open.
ex.zh: 我撕開了信封。

ex.en: Tom ripped up the letter.
ex.zh: 湯姆把信撕碎了。

rip.en: to tear something quickly and with force

ex.en: There's a rip in the back of your jeans.
ex.zh: 你牛仔褲的後面有一個破洞。

ex.en: She carefully sewed up the rip in her jacket.
ex.zh: 她小心地把外套上的裂口縫好。

rip.en: a long cut or tear in cloth or paper

ex.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
ex.zh: 這條法律會剝奪我們的基本權利。

ex.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
ex.zh: 基本人權當然應該受到尊重。

right.en: something you are allowed by law or morals to have or do

ex.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
ex.zh: 這間房子看起來不錯，而且價格也合理。

ex.en: You're right. I made a mistake.
ex.zh: 你說得對，我錯了。

ex.en: You have your right sock on wrong side out.
ex.zh: 你右腳的襪子穿反了。

ex.en: Turn right at the corner.
ex.zh: 在轉角右轉。

right.en: on the side of the body opposite the left

ex.en: I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我朋友現在正在電話上。

ex.en: I'll be right back.
ex.zh: 我馬上回來。

ex.en: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
ex.zh: 莊嚴的寺廟裡舉行了一場神聖的儀式。

ex.en: The Heavenly Timber Immolation is a kind of ancient ritual.
ex.zh: 燔柴祭天是一種古老的祭祀儀式。

ex.en: The sky cleared up after the ritual was over.
ex.zh: 祭祀結束後，天就放晴了。

ritual.en: a fixed set of actions done at special times, or a habit repeated in the same way

ex.en: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
ex.zh: 流經倫敦的河是泰晤士河。

ex.en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
ex.zh: 這條河對小孩來說游泳很危險。

ex.en: The rivers were flooded by the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨讓河水氾濫。

river.en: a large stream of water that flows across land to the sea

ex.en: Ridership rose after the city added late-night trains.
ex.zh: 市府增開深夜列車後，乘客人數有所增加。

ex.en: The transit agency tracks ridership on every route.
ex.zh: 大眾運輸機構會追蹤每條路線的載客量。

ridership.en: the number of people who travel on a bus or train system

ex.en: In order to do that, you have to take risks.
ex.zh: 要這麼做，你需要冒險。

ex.en: I don't want to run such a risk.
ex.zh: 我不想冒這個險。

ex.en: One who doesn't take risks will not win.
ex.zh: 不冒險就不會贏。

risk.en: the chance that something bad may happen

ex.en: He risked losing all his fortune.
ex.zh: 他冒著失去所有財產的危險。

ex.en: I know what you've risked.
ex.zh: 我知道你冒了多大的風險。

risk.en: to do something that may lead to a bad result

ex.en: The soldier carried a rifle on his shoulder.
ex.zh: 士兵肩上扛著一把步槍。

ex.en: The museum has an old rifle from the last century.
ex.zh: 博物館裡有一把上個世紀的舊步槍。

ex.en: He fell and broke a rib.
ex.zh: 他跌倒時摔斷了一根肋骨。

ex.en: The doctor checked her ribs carefully.
ex.zh: 醫生仔細檢查了她的肋骨。

ex.en: We ordered grilled ribs for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐點了烤肋排。

ex.en: The soup is made with pork ribs.
ex.zh: 這鍋湯是用豬排骨煮的。

ex.en: Water ran over the rim of the glass.
ex.zh: 水從杯子的邊緣溢了出來。

ex.en: He wears glasses with thin black rims.
ex.zh: 他戴著黑色細框的眼鏡。

ex.en: The ball hit the rim and bounced out.
ex.zh: 球打到籃框後彈了出來。

ex.en: He jumped high and grabbed the rim.
ex.zh: 他高高跳起並抓住了籃框。

ex.en: She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
ex.zh: 她在禮物盒上綁了一條紅色緞帶。

ex.en: The little girl wore a blue ribbon in her hair.
ex.zh: 小女孩頭髮上繫著一條藍色絲帶。

ex.en: The old printer needs a new ink ribbon.
ex.zh: 這台舊印表機需要換新的色帶。

ex.en: The typewriter stopped working because the ribbon was dry.
ex.zh: 因為色帶乾掉了，打字機無法使用。

ex.en: Richard is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 理查德是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Richard walks to work every morning.
ex.zh: 理查德每天早上走路上班。

ex.en: My teacher asked Richard to read the next page.
ex.zh: 老師請理查德念下一頁。

ex.en: The rising sun painted the sky orange.
ex.zh: 升起的太陽把天空染成橘色。

ex.en: Rising prices make it harder for families to save money.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的物價讓家庭更難存錢。

ex.en: She is a rising star in the film industry.
ex.zh: 她是電影界一顆新興的明星。

richmond.zh: 里奇蒙（美國維吉尼亞州首府）

ex.en: Richmond is the capital of the state of Virginia.
ex.zh: 里奇蒙是維吉尼亞州的首府。

ex.en: The James River flows through Richmond.
ex.zh: 詹姆斯河流經里奇蒙。

ex.en: These mangoes are ripe and ready to eat.
ex.zh: 這些芒果熟了，可以吃了。

ex.en: Wait until the tomatoes are ripe before you pick them.
ex.zh: 等番茄熟了再摘。

ex.en: A ripe banana is soft and sweet.
ex.zh: 熟透的香蕉又軟又甜。

ex.en: The village holds a traditional rite every spring.
ex.zh: 這個村莊每年春天都會舉行傳統儀式。

ex.en: Graduation is an important rite of passage for young people.
ex.zh: 畢業是年輕人重要的成長儀式。

ex.en: There is a friendly rivalry between the two schools.
ex.zh: 這兩所學校之間存在著友好的競爭。

ex.en: The rivalry between the brothers lasted for years.
ex.zh: 兄弟倆之間的較勁持續了好幾年。

ex.en: Rinse the vegetables under cold water before cooking.
ex.zh: 煮之前先用冷水沖洗蔬菜。

ex.en: He rinsed his mouth after brushing his teeth.
ex.zh: 他刷完牙後漱了口。

ex.en: Give the dishes a quick rinse before putting them in the machine.
ex.zh: 把碗盤放進洗碗機前先快速沖一下。

ex.en: She gave her hair a final rinse with cool water.
ex.zh: 她最後用涼水沖洗了頭髮。

ex.en: A small ripple spread across the pond.
ex.zh: 一圈小漣漪在池塘上擴散開來。

ex.en: The news sent a ripple of excitement through the crowd.
ex.zh: 這則消息在人群中引起一陣興奮的騷動。

ex.en: The lake rippled in the evening breeze.
ex.zh: 傍晚微風吹過，湖面泛起漣漪。

ex.en: Water rippled around the swimmer's legs.
ex.zh: 水在游泳者的腿邊泛起波紋。

ex.en: Rio de Janeiro is famous for its beaches and carnival.
ex.zh: 里約熱內盧以海灘和嘉年華聞名。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Rio each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天有許多遊客造訪里約。

ex.en: A deep rift ran across the dry ground.
ex.zh: 一道深深的裂縫橫過乾裂的地面。

ex.en: The argument created a rift between the two brothers.
ex.zh: 這場爭吵使兄弟倆之間產生了裂痕。

ex.en: A rift opened in the clouds and the sun came out.
ex.zh: 雲層裂開一道縫，太陽探了出來。

ex.en: I loved the richness of the chocolate cake.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡那塊巧克力蛋糕濃郁的口感。

ex.en: The richness of the soil helps crops grow well.
ex.zh: 土壤的肥沃讓農作物長得很好。

ex.en: The museum shows the richness of the island's culture.
ex.zh: 這座博物館展現了島上文化的豐富。

ex.en: He gave up his riches to live a simple life.
ex.zh: 他捨棄財富，過著簡單的生活。

ex.en: The story is about a poor boy who finds great riches.
ex.zh: 這個故事講的是一個窮男孩發現巨大財富。

ex.en: The hall was richly decorated with gold and red cloth.
ex.zh: 大廳以金色與紅色的布料華麗地裝飾著。

ex.en: She was richly rewarded for her hard work.
ex.zh: 她的努力得到了豐厚的回報。

ex.en: The soup was richly flavored with herbs.
ex.zh: 這道湯用香草調出了濃郁的風味。

ex.en: The study was done with great scientific rigour.
ex.zh: 這項研究以高度的科學嚴謹性完成。

ex.en: The rigour of army training surprised the new recruits.
ex.zh: 軍隊訓練的嚴格讓新兵很吃驚。

ex.en: The rigor of the training made the team stronger.
ex.zh: 嚴格的訓練讓球隊變得更強。

ex.en: Good research needs rigor in every step.
ex.zh: 好的研究在每個步驟都需要嚴謹。

ex.en: He faced ridicule from his classmates for his strange haircut.
ex.zh: 他因為奇怪的髮型被同學嘲笑。

ex.en: The idea was met with ridicule at first.
ex.zh: 這個想法起初遭到嘲笑。

ex.en: Don't ridicule others for making honest mistakes.
ex.zh: 不要因為別人犯了無心的錯誤就取笑他們。

ex.en: The newspaper ridiculed the mayor's plan.
ex.zh: 報紙嘲諷了市長的計畫。

ex.en: The phone is ringing in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 電話在廚房裡響著。

ex.en: The church bells were ringing all morning.
ex.zh: 教堂的鐘整個早上都在響。

ex.en: I heard a ringing in my ears after the loud concert.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的演唱會後，我耳朵一直嗡嗡作響。

ex.en: The ringing of the alarm woke me up.
ex.zh: 鬧鐘的鈴聲把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Horse riding is a popular hobby in the countryside.
ex.zh: 騎馬是鄉下很受歡迎的興趣。

ex.en: She goes riding every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 她每個週日早上都會去騎馬。

ex.en: Riding a bike to work saves me money.
ex.zh: 騎腳踏車上班幫我省了錢。

ex.en: We spent Saturday afternoon at the ice rink.
ex.zh: 我們週六下午都待在溜冰場。

ex.en: The new rink opens to skaters at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 新溜冰場九點開放給溜冰的人。

ex.en: The team follows the schedule rigidly.
ex.zh: 團隊嚴格遵守時程表。

ex.en: He stood rigidly at attention while the flag was raised.
ex.zh: 升旗時他僵直地立正站好。

ex.en: The prince returned to claim his rightful place on the throne.
ex.zh: 王子回來要奪回他應有的王位。

ex.en: The stolen bike was returned to its rightful owner.
ex.zh: 失竊的腳踏車被還給了它真正的主人。

ex.en: We had a picnic on the riverside last Sunday.
ex.zh: 上週日我們在河邊野餐。

ex.en: There is a bicycle path along the riverside.
ex.zh: 河畔有一條自行車道。

ex.en: Grate the lemon rind into the cake mixture.
ex.zh: 把檸檬皮磨碎加進蛋糕麵糊裡。

ex.en: He cut the rind off the cheese before eating it.
ex.zh: 他吃之前先把起司的外皮切掉。

ex.en: Rioting broke out in the city after the match.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，市區爆發了騷亂。

ex.en: The police were called in to stop the rioting.
ex.zh: 警方被叫來制止暴動。

ex.en: Crowds were rioting in the streets last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚群眾在街頭暴動。

ex.en: The prisoners were rioting over the poor food.
ex.zh: 囚犯們因為伙食太差而鬧事。

ex.en: Many rivers in this region flow into the sea.
ex.zh: 這個地區有許多河流注入大海。

ex.en: The Nile and the Amazon are two of the longest rivers in the world.
ex.zh: 尼羅河與亞馬遜河是世界上最長的兩條河。

ex.en: The new medicine was rigorously tested before it was approved.
ex.zh: 這種新藥在核准前經過嚴格測試。

ex.en: The coach rigorously follows the same training plan every week.
ex.zh: 教練每週都嚴格遵守同一套訓練計畫。

ex.en: Rumors were rife in the office after the announcement.
ex.zh: 公告之後，辦公室裡謠言四起。

ex.en: The old building is rife with problems, from leaks to bad wiring.
ex.zh: 這棟老建築問題叢生，從漏水到電線老舊都有。

ex.en: We crossed the river on a rickety wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 我們走過一座搖搖晃晃的木橋渡河。

ex.en: He sat down on a rickety old chair.
ex.zh: 他坐在一張搖晃的舊椅子上。

ex.en: The bridge is held together by thousands of steel rivets.
ex.zh: 這座橋靠數千根鋼鉚釘固定在一起。

ex.en: A loose rivet made the metal panel rattle.
ex.zh: 一根鬆掉的鉚釘讓金屬板嘎嘎作響。

ex.en: The story riveted the whole audience.
ex.zh: 這個故事吸引了所有觀眾。

ex.en: She was riveted by the magician's tricks.
ex.zh: 她被魔術師的把戲迷住了。

ex.en: The rigidity of the rules made the job difficult.
ex.zh: 規定的死板讓這份工作變得很難做。

ex.en: Cold weather increased the rigidity of the metal.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣使金屬變得更硬。

ex.en: The tickets were ridiculously expensive.
ex.zh: 那些票貴得離譜。

ex.en: He was ridiculously late for the meeting.
ex.zh: 他開會遲到得太離譜了。

ex.en: The tomatoes will ripen in a few more days.
ex.zh: 這些番茄再過幾天就會成熟。

ex.en: Leave the bananas on the counter to ripen.
ex.zh: 把香蕉放在流理台上讓它們熟透。

ex.en: We had a picnic on the riverbank.
ex.zh: 我們在河岸邊野餐。

ex.en: Tall trees grow along the riverbank.
ex.zh: 高大的樹沿著河岸生長。

ex.en: The land rightfully belongs to the villagers.
ex.zh: 這塊土地理所當然屬於村民。

ex.en: She rightfully received the prize for her hard work.
ex.zh: 她憑努力理所當然地得到了這個獎。

ex.en: He spoke with a strong sense of righteousness.
ex.zh: 他說話時帶著強烈的正義感。

ex.en: Many stories praise the righteousness of honest people.
ex.zh: 許多故事讚美誠實之人的正直。

ex.en: The guitarist played a catchy riff that everyone remembered.
ex.zh: 吉他手彈了一段讓大家都記住的順耳反覆樂句。

ex.en: The song starts with a simple bass riff.
ex.zh: 這首歌以一段簡單的貝斯反覆樂句開場。

ex.en: The author's new book is a riveting story about a long journey.
ex.zh: 作者的新書是一個關於漫長旅程、引人入勝的故事。

ex.en: We watched a riveting match that went into overtime.
ex.zh: 我們看了一場進入延長賽、精彩緊湊的比賽。

ex.en: We ordered mushroom risotto for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐點了蘑菇燉飯。

ex.en: Risotto needs slow cooking and a lot of stirring.
ex.zh: 燉飯需要慢慢煮，也要不停攪拌。

ex.en: Don't let his rude comments rile you.
ex.zh: 別讓他無禮的話惹惱你。

ex.en: It really riles me when people ignore the rules.
ex.zh: 有人無視規則時，真的讓我很生氣。

ex.en: We took a riverboat down the Mississippi.
ex.zh: 我們搭乘河船沿密西西比河而下。

ex.en: The old riverboat carried passengers between two towns.
ex.zh: 這艘老河船在兩個城鎮之間載客。

ex.en: A riverboat slowly passed under the bridge.
ex.zh: 一艘河船緩緩從橋下駛過。

rinsed.zh: 沖洗；漂洗（rinse 的過去式）

ex.en: She rinsed the dishes under cold water.
ex.zh: 她用冷水沖洗碗盤。

ex.en: He rinsed the soap out of his hair.
ex.zh: 他把頭髮上的肥皂沖乾淨。

ex.en: We rinsed the sand off our feet before getting in the car.
ex.zh: 上車前我們把腳上的沙沖掉。

ex.en: We sat by the rippling water of the pond.
ex.zh: 我們坐在泛著漣漪的池塘邊。

ex.en: The rippling muscles in his arms showed his strength.
ex.zh: 他手臂上起伏的肌肉顯示出他的力量。

ex.en: A rippling laugh came from the next room.
ex.zh: 隔壁房間傳來一陣清脆起伏的笑聲。

ex.en: We stuffed the pasta with ricotta and spinach.
ex.zh: 我們在義大利麵裡包了瑞可塔起司和菠菜。

ex.en: She spread ricotta on a slice of toast.
ex.zh: 她在一片吐司上抹了瑞可塔起司。

ex.en: Riparian forests protect river banks from erosion.
ex.zh: 河岸林能保護河堤不被侵蝕。

ex.en: The plan includes restoring the riparian zone along the stream.
ex.zh: 這項計畫包括恢復溪流沿岸的河岸地帶。

ex.en: My father is an early riser and walks the dog at five.
ex.zh: 我爸爸習慣早起，五點就去遛狗。

ex.en: I'm a late riser, so I avoid morning classes.
ex.zh: 我習慣晚起，所以避開早上的課。

ex.en: Each riser on these stairs is quite high.
ex.zh: 這座樓梯每一階的豎板都相當高。

ex.en: The carpenter painted the risers white and left the treads wooden.
ex.zh: 木工把樓梯豎板漆成白色，踏板則保留木頭原色。

ex.en: The stone ricocheted off the wall and landed in the pond.
ex.zh: 石頭從牆上彈開，掉進池塘裡。

ex.en: The ball ricocheted around the room before it stopped.
ex.zh: 球在房間裡彈來彈去才停下來。

ex.en: The ricochet of the ball surprised the goalkeeper.
ex.zh: 球的彈跳讓守門員大吃一驚。

ex.en: We heard the sharp ricochet of a pebble on the roof.
ex.zh: 我們聽到小石子在屋頂上彈跳的清脆聲響。

ripped.zh: 撕破；扯開（rip 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: He ripped the letter open and read it quickly.
ex.zh: 他把信撕開，很快讀了起來。

ex.en: She ripped her dress on a nail.
ex.zh: 她的洋裝被釘子勾破了。

ex.en: The wind ripped the sign off the wall.
ex.zh: 風把招牌從牆上扯了下來。

ex.en: He wore a pair of ripped jeans to the party.
ex.zh: 他穿著一條破牛仔褲去派對。

ex.en: The ripped bag could not hold the groceries.
ex.zh: 破掉的袋子裝不住那些雜貨。

ex.en: He works out daily and now looks really ripped.
ex.zh: 他每天健身，現在看起來肌肉線條很分明。

ex.en: The actor got ripped for his superhero role.
ex.zh: 那位演員為了超級英雄的角色練出了精壯的肌肉。

ex.en: The party was loud and riotous until midnight.
ex.zh: 這場派對一直喧鬧狂歡到午夜。

ex.en: The garden was a riotous mix of colors.
ex.zh: 花園裡色彩繽紛熱鬧。

ex.en: The sailors climbed the rigging to fix the sail.
ex.zh: 水手爬上索具去修理船帆。

ex.en: The ship's rigging was damaged in the storm.
ex.zh: 這艘船的索具在暴風雨中受損。

ex.en: They were accused of rigging the election.
ex.zh: 他們被指控操縱選舉。

ex.en: Rigging the contest ruined its fairness.
ex.zh: 對比賽做手腳破壞了它的公平性。

ex.en: The riverbed was dry after months without rain.
ex.zh: 幾個月沒下雨，河床都乾了。

ex.en: Children found smooth stones in the riverbed.
ex.zh: 孩子們在河床上找到了光滑的石頭。

ex.en: She wore a warm ribbed sweater to school.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件保暖的羅紋毛衣去上學。

ex.en: The socks have a ribbed top that stays up well.
ex.zh: 這雙襪子有羅紋的襪口，不容易滑落。

ex.en: Her quick riposte made the audience laugh.
ex.zh: 她機敏的回嘴逗得觀眾大笑。

ex.en: He had a sharp riposte for every question.
ex.zh: 每個問題他都有犀利的回應。
